artworks.title: Botanical-Milt
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Anne and Jacques Baruch Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a botanical illustration of a plant with a long green stem, pointed green leaves, and small budding flowers at the top. The color palette is muted, featuring light greens and browns against a soft beige background. The plant is positioned centrally, with its leaves extending outward and its flowers reaching upward, occupying most of the image's vertical space.

artworks.title: Botanical Sketch
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Anne and Jacques Baruch Collection
artworks.description: The image displays two botanical illustrations with handwritten annotations and sketches of plants. The plant on the left has red flowers and green leaves. On the right, there is a simple colored sketch of a grass-like plant with slender green leaves. The color scheme includes earthy greens and soft reds on a cream background. The left side showcases the colored illustration of the flowering plant at the top, while the right side features the tall sketch of the grass-like plant. Additional pencil sketches and notes are also present around the main illustrations.

artworks.title: Thistle
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Anne and Jacques Baruch Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a pencil drawing of a thistle plant with spiked leaves and a fluffy bloom at the top. The drawing is in shades of grey, creating a monochrome sketch. The thistle is centered and slightly to the right, with the flower head at the top and the curved stem extending downward with jagged leaves. The background is plain and textureless, emphasizing the details of the thistle.

artworks.title: Ornamental design with two birds pecking at fruit
artworks.medium: watercolor with pen and brown ink and graphite
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Anne and Jacques Baruch Collection
artworks.description: The image shows two blue birds surrounded by pink and white flowers with green leaves, set against a detailed, patterned background. The color palette includes beige, blue, pink, white, and green tones. The birds are at the bottom center of the image, surrounded by flowers and leaves, while the detailed pattern fills the upper part of the image.

artworks.title: Ornamental Design with Birds and Lily
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Anne Baruch in honor of Mrs. Ellen Nickel
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornamental scene with floral elements and birds. The drawing features lush floral patterns behind a putto-like figure seated on a decorated ledge, reaching towards a group of birds. The background includes swirling leaves and blossoms, while the architecture exhibits decorative motifs enhancing the classical aesthetics of the piece.

artworks.title: Nude and Fish with Flowers (Study for etched bathroom window)
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with graphite on paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Anne and Jacques Baruch Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a decorative design featuring floral motifs and a figure. The central portion of the drawing contains detailed pen work of a figure surrounded by intricate floral patterns. The figure is adorned with flowers and is encased within a grid-like structure that resembles stained glass or ornate windows. The floral patterns are repeated in columns on either side of the figure, creating a framed effect. The drawing is set against a plain background that seems to be a preparatory sketch with faint pencil lines.

artworks.title: Female Nude with Outstretched Arms
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Anne and Jacques Baruch Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body drawing of a female figure posed with her arms extended outward, one slightly higher than the other. She is standing on both feet, with a slight curve in her body. Her head is turned to the right and she has delicate facial features, softly defined eyes and nose, and styled hair. The figure is depicted without clothing or jewelry, highlighting the anatomical study of the human form. The background is plain, with no additional elements.

artworks.title: Female Nude with a Platter
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Anne and Jacques Baruch Collection
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a woman shown in profile from her head to her upper thighs. She has her arms outstretched. Her facial features are delicately drawn with a refined nose. She has an updo hairstyle with loose curls. She wears a small earring on her left ear and a form-fitting garment. The background is plain, and the drawing is on light brown paper.

artworks.title: Female Nude with Outstretched Arm
artworks.medium: graphite and red chalk on irregular sheet
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Anne and Jacques Baruch Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a full body drawing of a woman with her left arm extended to the side and her right hand near her chest. She has a slightly tilted head, closed eyes, and a relaxed expression. She has delicately outlined facial features with closed eyes, nose, and slightly open lips. Her hair is styled in an updo. The woman is nude, and there are no other objects or jewelry visible. The background is a plain, light brown paper with the artist's signature and the year "1898" at the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Drapery Study
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Anne and Jacques Baruch Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a large, flowing piece of fabric dominating the visual space. It is characterized by its folded and draped appearance, with a color palette of various shades of gray. The fabric starts from the upper left, cascading down diagonally towards the bottom right, with the folds creating areas of light and shadow across the composition.

artworks.title: Study of the shrub
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Anne and Jacques Baruch Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a branch with holly leaves in various colors and stages of drying. The color scheme includes shades of green, brown, red, and beige against a cream background. The branch extends diagonally from the lower left to the upper right, with red leaves prominent in the central area and green leaves at the edges.

artworks.title: Woman in Bath, Holding a Glass of Wine
artworks.medium: graphite on brown paper, mounted to green construction paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Anne and Jacques Baruch Collection
artworks.description: The image shows an upper body view of a person leaning over a horizontal surface. The person's face is turned to their left, looking slightly downward with a subtle smile. Their hair is styled back with an ornamental clip. The person is wearing a cloth or garment that loosely covers their shoulders. They hold a glass with a stem in their left hand. The background features sketchy cross-hatching strokes.

artworks.title: Angel
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Anne and Jacques Baruch Collection
artworks.description: The image shows an upper body portrait of a person drawn in a sketch style on light brown paper. The person's head is tilted slightly to one side, with soft facial features and elongated, curly hair. They wear a loose garment with a decorative collar, indicated by patterned lines around the neckline. A circular shape surrounds the head, resembling a halo. The sketch is primarily rendered in pencil with flowing lines, and the date "1915" is written in the lower right corner. The background is minimal.

artworks.title: Saint Benedict Reviving a Monk Killed by the Devil
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with graphite framing lines on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a group of robed figures with a mythical creature in ruins. One figure is lying on the ground, supported by another. A fantastical creature with wings emerges from behind a stone wall. A figure holds a heraldic shield with a crest. A gallows-like structure is seen on the left. The artwork depicts detailed line work and shading.

artworks.title: Anneliese Halbe
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Esther Klein
artworks.description: The image shows an artistic sketch of a seated person with folded hands. The person has pronounced eyebrows, a serious expression, and loosely styled hair. They wear a garment with a broad collar and decorative elements. The surroundings include fluid lines and shading hinting at a chair. The background is a light color with subtle shading and sketch lines.

artworks.title: Crinolines on the Beach
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache  over graphite on buff paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with multiple people gathered outdoors, some holding umbrellas. The drawing features several figures intricately sketched with light pencil and watercolor, wearing period clothing. The figures are depicted in various positions, with a distinct blue color highlighting certain clothing and umbrellas. The background is softly rendered, contributing to the scene's airy atmosphere.

artworks.title: Noon at Deauville
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows a group of individuals gathered at the edge of a beach. The scene features loose and fluid brushstrokes, with a soft and muted color palette. The horizon line separates the sandy shore from the ocean waves. The figures are wearing clothing typical of a past era.

artworks.title: The Miracle of Saint Mark (right side)
artworks.artist: John Baptist Jackson after Jacopo Tintoretto
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Jacob Kainen
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several figures gathered in front of a classical structure. The figures are engaged in different activities, with one reaching out, one holding an instrument, and others seated. The background features a classical architectural structure with columns and sculptural details. Light and shadow are used to accentuate the details in the drawing.

artworks.title: Santa Maria Maggiore
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and brown wash over graphite on vellum
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Joseph F. McCrindle in memory of Frederick A. den Broeder
artworks.description: The image depicts a bird's-eye view architectural sketch of a historical building with domes, a bell tower, columns, and arches. The sky is visible above the structures. The sketch features detailed linework and a soft sepia color palette, giving it an antique look. Other buildings are shown to the left, and in the distance to the right. Foliage is lightly shaded in the foreground.

artworks.title: Fleeing Barbarian
artworks.creditLine: Joseph F. McCrindle Collection
artworks.description: Drawn lightly with black chalk on tan-colored paper, a man runs to our right, lifting his right arm and looking back over his right shoulder so he faces us in this vertical drawing. His left leg, farther from us, is raised as he runs. A few lines suggest short curly hair and a beard, shadowed eyes, and his lips seem slightly parted. His thigh-length cape billows behind him, to our left, and he wears a fitted tunic or breastplate and pants cinched at the knee, calf, and ankle. He holds a round shield on his left arm. An annotation in ink in the top left corner reads, “no. 94.” A notation in the lower right, also in ink, reads, “i.91” near a seal or crest that appears to have been stamped in black ink.

artworks.title: Canards
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Martin Atlas
artworks.description: The image depicts a riverside scene with lush foliage and trees concealing the horizon. The lithograph shows detailed brushwork capturing textures of vegetation and water. The color palette is monochrome with various shades of black, gray, and white, emphasizing details and contrast. Ducks are in the water, one with raised wings, surrounded by lush plants and overhanging branches. Further back, dense greenery, trees, and shrubs blend into a misty background.

artworks.title: Shepherd Playing a Flute and Leading His Flock
artworks.medium: pen and two shades of brown ink over black chalk on brown laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Joseph F. McCrindle Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with a shepherd tending to a group of sheep assisted by a dog. Another shepherd is further along handling the herd. In the distance, there is a coastline with a structure emitting smoke and a small sailboat near the water's edge. The composition features intricate pen and ink work with detailed textures and forms. The color palette is dominated by earthy tones and dark brown ink, creating a warm visual impact. Rolling hills and a few trees are depicted with loose, expressive lines in the background.

artworks.title: Christ Falling under the Cross
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray-brown wash and black chalk, heightened with white gouache on brown laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Joseph F. McCrindle Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a person kneeling with a wooden cross over their right shoulder. The person has curly hair, a beard, a prominent nose, and is wearing a robe. The background is plain with a border.

artworks.title: Hilly Landscape with Ships
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash, heightened with white gouache, on blue laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Joseph F. McCrindle Collection
artworks.description: The image displays a rocky, tree-covered landscape. Two boats are in the water near the shore, with figures on them. The shoreline leads to hills with a building complex among trees. The horizon is vaguely defined by the water's edge. The artwork features light brushstrokes with brown ink, white highlights, and a blue-toned paper. The color palette includes soft browns, whites, and blue-greys.
